_comment: Video narration. {scene, text, spoken?}: scene is a manifest beat id, text is the burned caption, spoken overrides it for the voice where a symbol or identifier must not be read literally. startMs/endMs are absolute and written by capture/retime-captions.mjs from the real narration.mp3 -- never by hand. Both text and spoken are number-gated: every digit token must be sourceable in results/demo, or spelled out. Headline is the seat price against one brief; no monid_usd, no WoW claim, no PicPay figure; the X gap is stated.

narration.text: A social-listening seat is three hundred forty-nine dollars a month.
narration.spoken: A social listening seat is three hundred forty nine dollars a month.

narration.text: This is one full brief. Two dollars and twenty cents.
narration.spoken: This is one full brief. Two dollars and twenty cents.

The receipt reconciles. 42 runs, 37 billed, 11 empty, 0 failed.

PicPay doesn't clear the bar. Not enough data, so it says so.
Ask it anything; every citation opens a real post. X has no endpoint, and the receipt says that too.
A brand with nothing to find still gets a receipt. 0 mentions, still reconciled, still billed.
